model_provenance: Actual fallback disclosed by the session model-switch event: openai/gpt-6.1-sol after anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 provider quota failure. No role/default configuration changed.
scope: Independent V2-2 linguistic audit of all 73 EN/RU pairs, with 19 new picker/Manage keys; baseline comparison against git HEAD. No other locale audited.

findings.detail: «Группировать под {name}» is a literal English-calque construction and reads less naturally than the established Russian primary-tag wording. The meaning remains recoverable; placeholders are correct.
findings.recommendation: Use «Выбрано: {count}. Основной тег: {name}.» to align with group_under and updated_grouped.

findings.detail: The new copy uses «беседа/беседы/бесед» while all baseline conversation copy in this namespace uses «разговор/разговоры». Both are valid, but switching the entity term within one dialog is inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Prefer the established «разговор» terminology in these three new strings; preserve all Russian plural branches.

audit.pair_review: Read all 73 EN/RU pairs for meaning, grammar, register, punctuation, action wording and dynamic-name handling. No blocker or major found; two correctness-preserving language improvements recorded.
audit.key_integrity: 73/73 keys match EN. Exactly the requested 19 new suffixes in both files; all 54 baseline EN and RU values unchanged against HEAD.
audit.icu_execution: Using installed intl-messageformat: all 73 EN/RU messages parse, argument-name sets match per pair, and all 73 RU messages format for counts 0,1,2,5,11,21,22,25,101,1.5 (730 executions).
audit.plural_review: tag_usage explicitly supports Russian one/few/many/other: 1 беседа, 2 беседы, 5 бесед, 21 беседа, 22 беседы, 1,5 беседы. Baseline delete_description uses the correct governed genitive forms. Baseline remove_all intentionally uses exact =1 and other: 1 is singular action; 21 remains plural action. Count badges omit nouns and need no plural branches.
audit.reserved_name: Confirmed chat-tag-picker.ts rejects the literal case-insensitive name untagged; retaining «Untagged» in name_reserved is accurate even though the display label is localized «Без тега».
audit.length_risk: No new menu/toast copy is linguistically overlong enough to report a defect. reorder_filtered and registry_changed are longer feedback strings; user-authored names remain unbounded. Rendered wrapping/clipping and accessible-name presentation are explicitly left to later QA; no rendered-fit claim.
audit.register_punctuation: Neutral formal imperatives remain consistent; guillemets, ellipses, ranges, periods and name/count placeholders preserve intent.

verdict: clean — TERMINAL; zero blocker/major. The two minor findings are non-gating follow-ups.
